title: Playlist
description: The files this source plays, in order, and how the list repeats. The playout panel edits this for you; source.set with params changes it from anywhere else, and the project file keeps it.

items.title: Items
items.description: The files, in the order they play. Video (MP4, MOV, MKV, WebM), sound (MP3, WAV, FLAC, Ogg, M4A) and pictures (PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF, BMP, TIFF) can be mixed freely.

id.description: A short id unique in this list. Made from the path when left out.

path.description: The file, on the machine the mixer runs on.

title.description: What the panel shows. The file name when empty.

in_ms.description: Start this far into the file.

out_ms.description: Stop this far into the file. 0 is the end.

still_ms.description: How long a picture stays up. 0 uses still_seconds.

hold.description: Stop on this item's last frame and wait for play or next.

loop.title: Loop
loop.description: all: back to the top after the last item. one: the current item again and again. off: stop after the last item.

shuffle.title: Shuffle
shuffle.description: Play the list in a random order, a new one each time round.

at_end.title: When the list ends
at_end.description: With loop off: black, or hold the last frame.

still_seconds.title: Picture time
still_seconds.description: How long a picture stays up when its item does not say.

fit.title: Fit
fit.description: A file of another shape than the canvas: fit shows all of it with bars, fill crops it to fill the canvas, stretch squashes it to fit.

autoplay.title: Play at start
autoplay.description: Start playing as soon as the source starts.
